problem.title: Valid Parentheses
problem.statement: Given a string s containing only the characters ( ) [ ] { }, return true if every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket in the correct order, and every closing bracket has a matching opening bracket.

events.text: String up to 10^4 chars, only ()[]{}. Target O(n) time. What's the cleanest approach?
You can repeatedly delete matched pairs like "()" until nothing changes, or use a stack in one pass. Just pop on each closer and compare. If the loop finishes without a mismatch, return True.
That returns True for "((": nothing mismatches, but two openers are never closed. We need the stack to be empty at the end.
You're right, that was wrong. Thanks for the counterexample; use the corrected condition.
What edge cases should I test first: a lone closer, a leftover opener, interleaving like ([)]?
Those cover it. Your counterexample is a good test to keep.
